protocol.perKitRule: measuredPerKit (accepted from start to kit completion) <= perKitTolerance x perKit. Where (perKitTolerance - 1) x perKit is smaller than the entrance's own static storage (its dead-end entrance belt, 8 items per tile, plus its ring limit) the rule is applied to consumedPerKit (accepted minus what still sits on belts, the ring, machine inputs and arm hands at kit completion); this applies only to stone-brick (10 per kit, 20 items of static storage).

builds.feedPolicy: Declared west entrances only, throttled to their declared per-minute supply (belt credit capped at 8, one item at a time on alternating lanes; fluids per tick with a one-second carry); items removed only from declared east chests in the selective-refill step; no inventories seeded
